findings.title: Lint gate fails: rules-of-hooks false positive on PairForm's useThisPhone helper
findings.failure_scenario: npm run lint exits 1, blocking any lint-gated CI, because eslint's react-hooks rule sees a function named use* called inside an onPress callback at line 141. useThisPhone is an ordinary async function (line 65), not a hook — no React violation exists.
evidence: lint output: 'PairForm.tsx 141:29 error React Hook "useThisPhone" cannot be called inside a callback'
PairForm.tsx:65 — 'const useThisPhone = async () => {' — plain closure, no hook calls inside
reproduction_steps: cd app && npm run lint — exit 1, 1 error / 32 warnings
findings.suggested_remediation: Rename useThisPhone to e.g. pairThisPhone, or add a targeted eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/rules-of-hooks at line 141. Not a functional bug.
findings.limitations: JS-only check; no runtime impact verified beyond lint.

findings.title: test:order is mislabeled offline: it dials a live gateway and tests a mirrored copy of sessionList instead of the real module
findings.failure_scenario: The suite reads HERMES_DASHBOARD_SESSION_TOKEN from ~/.config/hermes-serve.env and opens ws://127.0.0.1:9119 to fetch real session rows; on any machine without a running gateway it exits 1 with 'no token', so 'test:order pass' does not mean the suite is deterministic. Worse, sortSessions/toMs are re-implemented locally ('/** Mirrors src/lib/sessionList.ts */') — the real src/lib/sessionList.ts is never imported, so the suite can stay green while the shipped sorting logic diverges (the exact BUG-103-class ordering bug it exists to guard could regress undetected).
evidence: test-session-order.ts:35 — '/** Mirrors src/lib/sessionList.ts */' followed by local toMs/sortSessions
grep of all suite imports: no suite imports src/lib/sessionList
reproduction_steps: cd app && npm run test:order — passed 7/7 only because a gateway was live on 127.0.0.1:9119; comment out the gateway process and it prints 'no token' and exit 1
findings.suggested_remediation: Import toMs/sortSessions from src/lib/sessionList.ts (strip RN-only deps or split pure helpers), and replace the live-gateway fetch with a fake in-process gateway like the other suites.
